1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Target canvas with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
10:   // Star field background
11:   const stars = [];
12:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
13:     stars.push({
14:       x: Math.random() * width,
15:       y: Math.random() * height,
16:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
17:     });
18:   }
19:   // Audio setup
20:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
21:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
22:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
23:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
24:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
25:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
26:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
27:     oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
28:     oscillator.start();
29:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
30:   }
31:   function playCollision() { playTone(150, 0.3); }
32:   function playSpawn() { playTone(300, 0.05); }
33:   function playStart() { playTone(400, 0.2); }
34: 
35:   // Ship (drawn as a triangle)
36:   const ship = {
37:     x: width / 2,
38:     y: height / 2,
39:     r: 12, // size (half‑width of triangle)
40:     speed: 4,
41:     dx: 0,
42:     dy: 0,
43:     angle: 0, // radians, direction ship faces
44:   };
45: 
46:   // Input handling (arrow keys)
47:   const keys = {};
48:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
49:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
50: 
51:   // Asteroids
52:   let asteroids = [];
53:   let spawnInterval = 2000; // ms
54:   let lastSpawn = 0;
55:   let speedFactor = 1;
56: 
57:   // Game state
58:   let startTime = null;
59:   let gameOver = false;
60: 
61:   function reset() {
62:     ship.x = width / 2; ship.y = height / 2; ship.dx = ship.dy = 0;
63:     asteroids = [];
64:     spawnInterval = 2000;
65:     speedFactor = 1;
66:     startTime = performance.now();
67:     gameOver = false;
68:     // Ensure audio context is running
69:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') {
70:       audioCtx.resume();
71:     }
72:     playStart();
73:   }
74: 
75:   function spawnAsteroid() {
76:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
77:     let x, y, dx, dy;
78:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 20;
79:     const speed = 1.5 * speedFactor + Math.random();
80:     // Place on a random edge
81:     if (side === 0) { x = -radius; y = Math.random() * height; dx = speed; dy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; }
82:     else if (side === 1) { x = width + radius; y = Math.random() * height; dx = -speed; dy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; }
83:     else if (side === 2) { x = Math.random() * width; y = -radius; dx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; dy = speed; }
84:     else { x = Math.random() * width; y = height + radius; dx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; dy = -speed; }
85:     asteroids.push({ x, y, r: radius, dx, dy });
86:     playSpawn();
87:   }
88: 
89:   function update(dt) {
90:     // Ship movement
91:     ship.dx = ship.dy = 0;
92:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.dy = -ship.speed;
93:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.dy = ship.speed;
94:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
95:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.dx = ship.speed;
96:     // Update ship angle when moving
97:     if (ship.dx !== 0 || ship.dy !== 0) {
98:       ship.angle = Math.atan2(ship.dy, ship.dx);
99:     }
100:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(width - ship.r, ship.x + ship.dx));
101:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(height - ship.r, ship.y + ship.dy));
102: 
103:     // Asteroids movement
104:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
105:       a.x += a.dx * dt;
106:       a.y += a.dy * dt;
107:     });
108:     // Remove off‑screen asteroids
109:     asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => a.x + a.r > -50 && a.x - a.r < width + 50 && a.y + a.r > -50 && a.y - a.r < height + 50);
110: 
111:     // Collision detection
112:     for (const a of asteroids) {
113:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
114:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
115:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
116:       if (dist < a.r + ship.r) { gameOver = true; playCollision(); break; }
117:     }
118: 
119:     // Increase difficulty
120:     if (!gameOver && performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
121:       spawnAsteroid();
122:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
123:       // Gradually speed up and spawn more often
124:       speedFactor += 0.02;
125:       spawnInterval = Math.max(500, spawnInterval * 0.97);
126:     }
127:   }
128: 
129:   function draw() {
130:     // Background
131:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
132:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
133:     // Stars
134:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
135:     stars.forEach(s => {
136:       ctx.beginPath();
137:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
138:       ctx.fill();
139:     });
140:     // Ship (triangle)
141:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
142:     ctx.save();
143:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
144:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
145:     ctx.beginPath();
146:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.r);
147:     ctx.lineTo(ship.r * 0.8, ship.r);
148:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r * 0.8, ship.r);
149:     ctx.closePath();
150:     ctx.fill();
151:     ctx.restore();
152:     // Asteroids (shaded circles)
153:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
154:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.3, a.x, a.y, a.r);
155:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
156:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#444');
157:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
158:       ctx.beginPath();
159:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
160:       ctx.fill();
161:     });
162:     // Score
163:     const elapsed = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
164:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
165:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
166:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 20);
167:     // Game over overlay
168:     if (gameOver) {
169:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
170:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
171:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
172:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
173:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
174:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2 - 20);
175:       ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
176:       ctx.fillText('Click to restart', width / 2, height / 2 + 20);
177:     }
178:   }
179: 
180:   function loop(timestamp) {
181:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
182:     const dt = (timestamp - (lastFrame || timestamp)) / 16; // normalize ~60fps
183:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
184:     draw();
185:     lastFrame = timestamp;
186:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
187:   }
188: 
189:   canvas.addEventListener('click', () => { if (gameOver) reset(); });
190:   reset();
191:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
192: })();

(End of file - total 192 lines)
